home.untouched: Resolution, keybinds and sensitivity are never touched
level.quality.desc: Looks the same; only hidden FPS-eating settings go off.
level.balanced.desc: Shadows and effects drop, textures stay.
level.maxfps.desc: Everything for FPS. The image gets simpler.
level.competitive.desc: Max FPS + low latency, clearer enemies.
boost.gameRunning: Close the game first; settings are applied while it is closed.
boost.settingsFailed: Couldn't write the game's settings file. Nothing was changed.
boost.notFound: The game's settings file wasn't found. Launch the game once, close it and try again.
boost.wait: Wait until the game closes and freeze background apps
net.note: BoostRoot never changes network settings; it only measures.
stress.note: The test stops by itself above the safety limits (GPU 90°C, hotspot 105°C). Don't play while it runs.
stress.errors: Calculation errors — CPU: {0}, GPU: {1}, RAM: {2}. Undo any overclock/undervolt; for RAM errors lower XMP one step.
stress.throttle: CPU slowed down when hot ({0}%). Check thermal paste/fans.
stress.gpuWindow: BoostRoot — GPU stress test (Esc to close)
fps.title: FPS Test
fps.howto: 1) Open the game and stand in the same spot/scene. 2) Press "Measure before boost" and switch to the game within 5 s. 3) Apply the boost, restart the game and "Measure after boost" in the same spot. BoostRoot calculates the difference.
fps.countdown: Switch to the game — starting in {0} s
fps.err.presentmon-missing: The FPS tool (PresentMon) is missing. Reinstall BoostRoot.
fps.err.noFrames: No frames captured. Was the game open and in front?
settings.chEnabled: Show crosshair when the game starts
settings.replay: Keep recording the last moments (save with Alt+F10)
settings.discord: Discord webhook URL (sends clips to a channel)
settings.hotkeys: Hotkeys: Alt+O overlay · Alt+C crosshair · Alt+F10 save last moments · Alt+F9 start/stop recording · Alt+F1 screenshot
settings.overlayNote: The overlay and crosshair never enter the game; they are separate windows on top, so they are safe with Vanguard/EAC and never appear in clips. Note: they may not show in exclusive fullscreen; borderless always works.
home.stretchNote: While the game runs the desktop switches to 4:3 filling the screen; it goes back when the game closes.
